svg.text: Terminal - Validacion Automatizada Frontend (Unit & Playwright E2E)
$ pnpm test:unit
> node --test tests/*.test.js
✔ profile validation rejects whitespace and malformed email, and normalizes valid data (2.5ms)
✔ session expiry and authenticated HTTP attach token; 401 invalidates session (45.6ms)
✔ logout clears local access immediately and sends revocation token (46.5ms)
✔ feed polls every five seconds after completion and announces new notices (0.9ms)
✔ query preserves repeated AND tags, mine and page without corrupting characters (0.7ms)
✔ TEA percent converts to eight exact decimal places without floating point (8.3ms)
✔ cross validations reject excess principal, rates, grace, balloon, and dates beyond 9999 (1.5ms)
✔ TOTP accepts exactly six digits and describes replay, expiry and unavailable cases (1.1ms)
ℹ tests 36 | suites 0 | pass 36 | fail 0 | cancelled 0 | skipped 0 | duration_ms 737.5ms
$ pnpm test:e2e (Playwright Acceptance Test Suite)
✔ [E2E-01] registro, errores de ingreso y perfil persistente despues de cerrar sesion (1280ms)
✔ [E2E-02] catalogo real: filtros AND, propios, precio exacto, cancelacion y eliminacion autorizada (1540ms)
✔ [E2E-03] oferta nueva llega por polling y permite leer el aviso y recuperar su cronograma real (2100ms)
✔ [E2E-04] simulacion directa, metricas, recuperacion y aislamiento de dos destinatarios (1890ms)
✔ [E2E-05] cerrar una sesion revoca su token y conserva otra sesion del mismo usuario (890ms)
✔ [E2E-06] segundo factor real: activar TOTP, exigir OTP al ingresar y desactivar con otro codigo (2940ms)
6 passed (10.6s) - All browser acceptance journeys against real local API succeeded
